findings.reason: the plan must name a span source that yields identity-less section-element spans (project the protected set from the parser's own raw span list, not from `plan_headings` records), or the consolidation regresses the store boundary protection it exists to preserve.
findings.text: §17 states `structured_section_spans` "keeps its spans-only contract but is expressed as a projection of `plan_headings`' records", yet that reader yields one named record per heading, and the protected-span set the store's boundary protection consumes also includes spans with no identity-bearing heading: measured on `docs/plans/a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-is-built.html`, `structured_section_spans` returns 18 spans, of which 3 are the `<section data-reckon="decisions"|"followups"|"comments">` regions whose `<h2>` carries no `id`/`data-id` and which no `section_record_id`-keyed heading record describes, so a projection built only on per-heading records silently drops them and the `_splice_section`/`_reject_emptying_unparsed_section` boundary protection stops covering those machinery regions

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the plan re-expresses `structured_section_spans` as "a projection of `plan_headings`' records", but that reader yields one record per heading while the protected-span set it must reproduce also contains identity-less machinery-section spans.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §16 hoists `section_record_id`/`section_id_candidates` to one owner, §17 re-homes `landed_section_ids` and the store's span helpers onto the existing span parser rather than beside it, and §18 names `plan_review.RUN_COMMENT_PREFIX` as the owner promotion should import instead of its own `_LANDING_COMMENT_PREFIX`; each names the file to extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1477, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; each of §16, §17, §18 carries its own interface-accounting text naming what it retires or moves (`landed_section_ids`, `plan_fingerprint`'s `legacy` flag) or stating why nothing can be (kept public callers), and their sum (+4: `strip_tags`, `plan_headings`, the machinery-element predicate, the classification predicate) matches the per-section figures.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design sections cite the mechanisms they extend or re-home (`structured_section_spans`, `_TAG_RE`/`count_open_decisions`, `landed_section_ids`, `_fingerprint_forms`, `roadmap.implementable_sections`) and each citation was checked against the code: `_plan_html.py:94/1506/1525`, `_store.py:1075`, `plan_review.py:598`, `roadmap.py:106` all exist as named.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one thin exposure, `strip_tags` on `reckon/_plan_html.py`, is justified as exposing the existing `_TAG_RE` across the package boundary and folding `count_open_decisions` onto it, so the expression keeps one caller rather than gaining a parallel one.
